evidence.detail: PD validation only checks 'sum(maindeck) < 60'; no upper-bound check on main deck size, so 75 main + 0 sideboard passes validation

text-format parser fallback path fills exactly 60 into main then up to 15 into sideboard; XML parser uses Sideboard='true'/'false' per card — if all cards were exported with Sideboard='false' a 75-card deck would land entirely in main
GatherlingDeck dataclass has separate maindeck/sideboard fields; unclear if source data could collapse them for berluspooky36's specific decks without DB access

triage.notes: There is a clear validation gap (no max-60-main check in legality.py), but whether this caused the specific berluspooky36 decks or the decks arrived via a parsing/import edge case cannot be determined without database access to inspect the submitted decklists.
